Description: Store all .flow schedule/app/workflow triggers as database rows instead of static cron jobs.
Acceptance Criteria: workflow_triggers table exists and compile step writes trigger rows.

Description: Static scheduled Inngest function scans due trigger rows and emits workflow/run.requested events.
Acceptance Criteria: Due triggers run without creating one function per workflow.

Description: Support skip, run_once, catch_up_limited, ask_user for missed schedules.
Acceptance Criteria: Missed schedules do not flood the system.

Description: Spread scheduled runs across a jitter window to prevent load spikes.
Acceptance Criteria: Scheduler applies jitter to trigger fire time.

Description: Use workflow_id + trigger_id + scheduled_for idempotency key.
Acceptance Criteria: Duplicate scheduler ticks do not create duplicate runs.

Description: Normalize Gmail/Stripe/Shopify/webhook events into EventContextPackets.
Acceptance Criteria: External events can trigger workflows through one endpoint.

Description: Match EventContextPackets against workflow_triggers match_rules and trigger workflow jobs.
Acceptance Criteria: App and workflow events can start jobs.

Description: Define EventContextPacket schema for app, workflow, task, and worker context.
Acceptance Criteria: Workers and apps emit standard context packets.

Description: Define TaskReport schema for subworkers to report outputs, issues, costs, and suggested patches.
Acceptance Criteria: Each task run stores a task report.

Description: Route events to tasks, UI, other workflows, and main AI according to .flow routing rules.
Acceptance Criteria: Image worker can notify scheduler without waking main AI.

Description: Generate compressed context packets for main AI only when reflection rules trigger.
Acceptance Criteria: Main AI receives compressed run summary, not raw logs.

Description: One Inngest function loads compiled .flow JSON and dispatches task types.
Acceptance Criteria: All workflows run through same generic executor.

Description: Resume workflows waiting on human approval decisions.
Acceptance Criteria: Approval decisions wake waiting runs.

Description: Signed callback endpoint/function for async workers to return task reports and artifacts.
Acceptance Criteria: Async worker callbacks become events/task reports.

Description: Generate reflection packets and patch proposals after issues or scheduled reviews.
Acceptance Criteria: Reflection runs only when configured.

Description: Dispatch per-chat workflow notifications to in-app/email/Slack/SMS/webhook.
Acceptance Criteria: Notifications are routed by workflow settings.

Description: Roll up usage events into credit ledger and billing records.
Acceptance Criteria: Credit billing can be enforced.

Description: Find stuck, timed-out, or unhealthy workflow runs and create issue cards.
Acceptance Criteria: Stuck runs are surfaced.

Description: Limit active runs and steps per organization.
Acceptance Criteria: No org can overwhelm runtime.

Description: Throttle tool calls by provider/account/org to respect API limits.
Acceptance Criteria: External APIs are protected.

Description: Detect and pause webhook sources producing abnormal event volume.
Acceptance Criteria: Event storms create issue cards instead of unlimited runs.

Description: Every foreach must have max_items and max_parallelism.
Acceptance Criteria: Unbounded fanout is rejected by semantic validator.

Description: Meter run start, ai_task, tool_call, sandbox seconds, image generation, reflection, and event volume.
Acceptance Criteria: Every task records usage events.

Description: Limit active triggers, min intervals, and runs per day by plan.
Acceptance Criteria: Free/Starter users cannot create runaway schedules.
